note: 0.5 dev.17 (Osama, 6 November 2026). Infantry in buildings take 18% (floor 0.13 -> 0.18, still 0 per soldier). 120 mm and 125 mm tank HE ignore cover 0.3 -> 0.25, so one shell kills about 1 man in a building. Ground-vehicle autocannon HE ignore cover 0 -> 0.125. Damage that gets through = Damage x (floor + (1 - floor) x IgnoreCover), read from ShellHitSystem.DamageBuilding.
